# STD-TEC-EKS-006: Security

**Standards Metadata**

```yaml
standard_id: 'STD-TEC-EKS-006'
standard_name: 'EKS Security'
standard_type: 'technology'
category: 'technology'
version: '1.0.0'
status: 'active'
compliance_level: 'mandatory'
tags: ['technology', 'eks', 'kubernetes', 'security', 'rbac', 'mandatory']
```

---

> Defines security standards for Amazon EKS clusters within enterprise environments. Ensures comprehensive security controls are implemented across all Kubernetes workloads, following security best practices and compliance requirements with pod security, RBAC, secret management, and network security policies.

---
page_texts.3:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#purpose]

## Purpose

This standard establishes requirements for securing Amazon EKS clusters to ensure comprehensive security controls are implemented across all Kubernetes workloads.
page_texts.5:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#21-pod-security-context]

### 2.1 Pod Security Context

**Mandatory Security Context**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-api
spec:
    securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        supplementalGroups: [1000]
    containers:
        - name: app
          securityContext:
              allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
              readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
              runAsNonRoot: true
              runAsUser: 1000
              runAsGroup: 1000
              capabilities:
                  drop:
                      - ALL
                  add:
                      - NET_BIND_SERVICE # Only if needed for port < 1024
```
page_texts.6:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#22-pod-security-standards-policy]

### 2.2 Pod Security Standards Policy

**Restricted Pod Security Standard**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth
    labels:
        pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
        pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
        pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
```

**Pod Security Policy Template**:

```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1beta1
kind: PodSecurityPolicy
metadata:
    name: fusion-restricted-psp
spec:
    privileged: false
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    requiredDropCapabilities:
        - ALL
    volumes:
        - 'configMap'
        - 'emptyDir'
        - 'projected'
        - 'secret'
        - 'downwardAPI'
        - 'persistentVolumeClaim'
    runAsUser:
        rule: 'MustRunAsNonRoot'
    seLinux:
        rule: 'RunAsAny'
    fsGroup:
        rule: 'RunAsAny'
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
```
page_texts.7:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#23-resource-limits-and-security]

### 2.3 Resource Limits and Security

**Security-Focused Resource Limits**:

```yaml
resources:
    limits:
        cpu: 1000m
        memory: 1Gi
        ephemeral-storage: 2Gi
    requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
        ephemeral-storage: 1Gi
```

**Prevent Resource Exhaustion**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: LimitRange
metadata:
    name: fusion-security-limits
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    limits:
        - default:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          defaultRequest:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
          max:
              cpu: 2000m
              memory: 4Gi
          min:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
          type: Container
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#31-service-account-management]

### 3.1 Service Account Management

**Application Service Account**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-api
    namespace: fusion-auth
    annotations:
        eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/fusion-auth-api-role
automountServiceAccountToken: false
```

**Service Account Token Mounting**:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
    template:
        spec:
            serviceAccountName: fusion-auth-api
            automountServiceAccountToken: false
            containers:
                - name: app
                  volumeMounts:
                      - name: service-account-token
                        mountPath: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
                        readOnly: true
            volumes:
                - name: service-account-token
                  projected:
                      sources:
                          - serviceAccountToken:
                                expirationSeconds: 3600
                                path: token
                          - configMap:
                                name: kube-root-ca.crt
                                items:
                                    - key: ca.crt
                                      path: ca.crt
                          - downwardAPI:
                                items:
                                    - path: namespace
                                      fieldRef:
                                          fieldPath: metadata.namespace
```
page_texts.10:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#32-role-based-access-control]

### 3.2 Role-Based Access Control

**Application Role**:

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
    namespace: fusion-auth
    name: fusion-auth-api-role
rules:
    - apiGroups: ['']
      resources: ['configmaps', 'secrets']
      verbs: ['get', 'list']
    - apiGroups: ['']
      resources: ['pods']
      verbs: ['get', 'list']
      resourceNames: [] # Restrict to specific pods if needed
```

**Role Binding**:

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-api-binding
    namespace: fusion-auth
subjects:
    - kind: ServiceAccount
      name: fusion-auth-api
      namespace: fusion-auth
roleRef:
    kind: Role
    name: fusion-auth-api-role
    apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

**Cross-Namespace Access (ClusterRole)**:

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
    name: fusion-monitoring-reader
rules:
    - apiGroups: ['']
      resources: ['pods', 'services', 'endpoints']
      verbs: ['get', 'list', 'watch']
    - apiGroups: ['apps']
      resources: ['deployments', 'replicasets']
      verbs: ['get', 'list', 'watch']
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#33-rbac-best-practices]

### 3.3 RBAC Best Practices

**Principle of Least Privilege**:

- Grant minimum required permissions
- Use specific resource names when possible
- Avoid wildcard permissions
- Regular RBAC audits and cleanup

**RBAC Templates by Role**:

**Application Pod Role**:

```yaml
rules:
    - apiGroups: ['']
      resources: ['configmaps']
      verbs: ['get']
      resourceNames: ['app-config']
    - apiGroups: ['']
      resources: ['secrets']
      verbs: ['get']
      resourceNames: ['app-secrets']
```

**Monitoring Role**:

```yaml
rules:
    - apiGroups: ['']
      resources: ['pods', 'services', 'endpoints']
      verbs: ['get', 'list', 'watch']
    - apiGroups: ['metrics.k8s.io']
      resources: ['pods', 'nodes']
      verbs: ['get', 'list']
```
page_texts.13:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#41-kubernetes-secrets]

### 4.1 Kubernetes Secrets

**Secret Creation Standards**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-secrets
    namespace: fusion-auth
    annotations:
        reloader.stakater.com/match: 'true'
type: Opaque
stringData:
    database-url: 'postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db'
    jwt-secret: 'super-secret-key'
    redis-password: 'redis-password'
```

**Secret Rotation Policy**:

- **Rotation Frequency**: Every 90 days minimum
- **Automated Rotation**: Use External Secrets Operator
- **Secret Versioning**: Maintain previous version during rotation
- **Access Logging**: Log all secret access

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#42-external-secrets-integration]

### 4.2 External Secrets Integration

**AWS Secrets Manager Integration**:

```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: SecretStore
metadata:
    name: fusion-aws-secrets
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    provider:
        aws:
            service: SecretsManager
            region: us-east-1
            auth:
                serviceAccount:
                    name: external-secrets-sa
```

**External Secret Definition**:

```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-external-secret
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    refreshInterval: 15m
    secretStoreRef:
        name: fusion-aws-secrets
        kind: SecretStore
    target:
        name: fusion-auth-secrets
        creationPolicy: Owner
    data:
        - secretKey: database-url
          remoteRef:
              key: fusion/auth/database
              property: url
        - secretKey: jwt-secret
          remoteRef:
              key: fusion/auth/jwt
              property: secret
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#43-secret-security-best-practices]

### 4.3 Secret Security Best Practices

**Secret Access Control**:

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
    namespace: fusion-auth
    name: secret-reader
rules:
    - apiGroups: ['']
      resources: ['secrets']
      verbs: ['get']
      resourceNames: ['fusion-auth-secrets']
```

**Secret Encryption at Rest**:

```yaml
apiVersion: apiserver.k8s.io/v1
kind: EncryptionConfiguration
resources:
    - resources:
          - secrets
      providers:
          - kms:
                name: fusion-kms-key
                endpoint: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:key/12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012
                cachesize: 100
                timeout: 3s
          - identity: {}
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#51-network-policies]

### 5.1 Network Policies

**Default Deny Policy**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: deny-all
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    podSelector: {}
    policyTypes:
        - Ingress
        - Egress
```

**Microservice Communication Policy**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-api-policy
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    podSelector:
        matchLabels:
            app.kubernetes.io/name: fusion-auth-api
    policyTypes:
        - Ingress
        - Egress
    ingress:
        - from:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        name: fusion-gateway
              - podSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        app.kubernetes.io/name: api-gateway
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 8000
    egress:
        - to:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        name: fusion-db
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 5432
        - to: []
          ports:
              - protocol: UDP
                port: 53 # DNS
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#52-service-mesh-security]

### 5.2 Service Mesh Security

**Istio mTLS Configuration**:

```yaml
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: PeerAuthentication
metadata:
    name: default
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    mtls:
        mode: STRICT
```

**Authorization Policy**:

```yaml
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-authz
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    selector:
        matchLabels:
            app: fusion-auth-api
    rules:
        - from:
              - source:
                    principals: ['cluster.local/ns/fusion-gateway/sa/api-gateway']
          to:
              - operation:
                    methods: ['GET', 'POST']
                    paths: ['/auth/*']
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#61-container-image-standards]

### 6.1 Container Image Standards

**Image Security Requirements**:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
    template:
        spec:
            containers:
                - name: app
                  image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/fusion/auth-api:1.0.0-abc123
                  imagePullPolicy: Always
                  securityContext:
                      runAsNonRoot: true
                      runAsUser: 1000
                      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
```

**Image Pull Secrets**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
    name: ecr-registry-secret
    namespace: fusion-auth
type: kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson
data:
    .dockerconfigjson: <base64-encoded-docker-config>
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#62-image-scanning-and-validation]

### 6.2 Image Scanning and Validation

**ECR Image Scanning**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: image-security-policy
data:
    policy.json: |
        {
          "rules": [
            {
              "action": "DENY",
              "condition": {
                "vulnerabilities": {
                  "critical": "> 0"
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "action": "WARN",
              "condition": {
                "vulnerabilities": {
                  "high": "> 5"
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }
```

**Admission Controller for Image Validation**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionWebhook
metadata:
    name: image-security-webhook
webhooks:
    - name: validate-images.fusion.com
      clientConfig:
          service:
              name: image-validator
              namespace: kube-system
              path: /validate
      rules:
          - operations: ['CREATE', 'UPDATE']
            apiGroups: ['apps']
            apiVersions: ['v1']
            resources: ['deployments']
      admissionReviewVersions: ['v1']
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#72-opa-gatekeeper-policies]

### 7.2 OPA Gatekeeper Policies

**Gatekeeper Installation**:

```yaml
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
    name: fusionrequiredsecuritycontext
spec:
    crd:
        spec:
            names:
                kind: FusionRequiredSecurityContext
            validation:
                openAPIV3Schema:
                    type: object
    targets:
        - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
          rego: |
              package fusionrequiredsecuritycontext

              violation[{"msg": msg}] {
                container := input.review.object.spec.containers[_]
                not container.securityContext.runAsNonRoot
                msg := "Container must run as non-root user"
              }

              violation[{"msg": msg}] {
                container := input.review.object.spec.containers[_]
                not container.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem
                msg := "Container must have read-only root filesystem"
              }
```

**Security Context Constraint**:

```yaml
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: FusionRequiredSecurityContext
metadata:
    name: fusion-security-context
spec:
    match:
        kinds:
            - apiGroups: ['apps']
              kinds: ['Deployment']
        excludedNamespaces: ['kube-system', 'kube-public']
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#91-audit-logging]

### 9.1 Audit Logging

**Audit Log Configuration**:

```yaml
apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1
kind: Policy
rules:
    - level: Metadata
      namespaces: ['fusion-auth', 'fusion-admin']
      resources:
          - group: ''
            resources: ['secrets', 'configmaps']
          - group: 'rbac.authorization.k8s.io'
            resources: ['roles', 'rolebindings']

    - level: Request
      namespaces: ['fusion-auth']
      resources:
          - group: ''
            resources: ['pods']
      verbs: ['create', 'delete', 'update', 'patch']

    - level: RequestResponse
      resources:
          - group: ''
            resources: ['secrets']
      verbs: ['get', 'list']
```
page_texts.31:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#92-security-monitoring]

### 9.2 Security Monitoring

**Falco Security Rules**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: falco-rules
    namespace: falco-system
data:
    fusion_rules.yaml: |
        - rule: Unauthorized Process in Container
          desc: Detect unauthorized process execution
          condition: >
            spawned_process and container
            and not proc.name in (python, java, node, /app/main)
          output: >
            Unauthorized process in container
            (user=%user.name command=%proc.cmdline container=%container.name)
          priority: WARNING

        - rule: Sensitive File Access
          desc: Detect access to sensitive files
          condition: >
            open_read and fd.name in (/etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /root/.ssh)
          output: >
            Sensitive file accessed
            (user=%user.name file=%fd.name container=%container.name)
          priority: CRITICAL
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-006-security.md#93-compliance-scanning]

### 9.3 Compliance Scanning

**CIS Kubernetes Benchmark**:

```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
    name: kube-bench
    namespace: kube-system
spec:
    template:
        spec:
            hostPID: true
            containers:
                - name: kube-bench
                  image: aquasec/kube-bench:latest
                  command: ['kube-bench', '--version', 'eks-1.28']
                  volumeMounts:
                      - name: var-lib-etcd
                        mountPath: /var/lib/etcd
                        readOnly: true
                      - name: var-lib-kubelet
                        mountPath: /var/lib/kubelet
                        readOnly: true
                      - name: etc-kubernetes
                        mountPath: /etc/kubernetes
                        readOnly: true
            volumes:
                - name: var-lib-etcd
                  hostPath:
                      path: '/var/lib/etcd'
                - name: var-lib-kubelet
                  hostPath:
                      path: '/var/lib/kubelet'
                - name: etc-kubernetes
                  hostPath:
                      path: '/etc/kubernetes'
            restartPolicy: Never
```
